turns.question: How much of our campaigns' budget was left at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: 4,130.00 EUR of campaign budget was left at the end of September 2026 (1-30 September, each campaign's last snapshot in the period, added up). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
